delivery_title: How this site reaches your browser
delivery_1_text: You visit the portfolio address and your browser starts an HTTPS connection.
delivery_2_text: The connection is routed to the public IP of the AWS instance.
delivery_3_text: Inbound rules allow the connection on port 443 (HTTPS).
delivery_4_text: nginx establishes the TLS connection and receives the HTTP request.
delivery_5_text: nginx reads the static page for your chosen language and the CSS files.
delivery_6_text: HTML and CSS return over HTTPS. Your browser assembles and displays the site; a small script restores your theme preference.
